title: Evidence item counts are identical whether queried via the org-scoped or project-scoped evidence endpoint
description: Sanity check that GET /api/evidence/organization/:orgId and the sum of GET /api/evidence/project/:projectId across all of the org's projects agree in count — since compliance-vault has no data of its own, any vault-hub total must reconcile with evidence-management's totals exactly.
preconditions: An org with evidence items spread across 2+ projects
steps: Call GET /api/evidence/organization/:orgId and note the total count
Call GET /api/evidence/project/:projectId for each project in the org and sum the counts
expectedResult: The two totals match exactly (accounting for isLatest/status filtering being applied consistently in both) — no drift between the two views of the same underlying collection.

title: The working Google Drive detail page at /evidence-management/gdrive loads successfully as a sanity baseline before testing the broken compliance-vault deep link
description: Establishes that the real, existing gdrive integration page (src/app/(private)/evidence-management/gdrive/page.jsx) is itself functional, isolating the defect in CPVT-E2E-002 to the URL construction in GoogleDriveIntegrationCard.js rather than a broader Google Drive integration outage.
expectedResult: Page loads successfully showing Google Drive sync/folder status — confirming the underlying integration works and the only issue is the incorrect '/compliance-vault/...' link target used elsewhere in the app.

title: A newly-created evidence item defaults to status 'draft' regardless of which UI surface initiated the upload
description: evidence.model.js's status field default is 'draft' (line ~49-54) except when sourceType is audit/intelli_audit/corrective_action, which start at 'closed' per the comment at line 41. Sanity check that this default holds true for a manual upload, since any vault-facing upload path (were one to exist) would reuse the same model.
steps: Upload a new evidence item with sourceType='manual_upload' and no explicit status override
Fetch the created item and inspect its status field

title: A single file download produces exactly one 'data.export.download' activity log entry, not a duplicate per click
description: Sanity check paired with CPVT-INT-004 — guards against a double-fire bug (e.g. React StrictMode double-invoking an effect, or a retry-on-slow-network path) inflating a vault-style audit trail with phantom access records.
steps: Click 'Download' once on an evidence file attachment
Query the activity log for 'data.export.download' events tied to this evidenceId/fileId/user/timestamp window
expectedResult: Exactly one matching activity log entry exists, not two or more.

title: A user with evidence.read but zero accessible evidence items sees an empty state, not an error
description: Sanity check for a fresh project/org with no evidence yet uploaded — since compliance-vault would display this same data, its (currently non-existent) hub must not crash on an empty array response.
preconditions: A freshly-created project with no evidence uploaded
steps: As a member of the fresh project with evidence.read, call GET /api/evidence/project/:projectId
expectedResult: 200 OK with an empty array — no error, no null-pointer-style failure downstream in any consuming UI.
